provenance.steps: Loan L1 opens at 500 in 2024-01 with scheduled principal 10 in each later month. In 2024-02 the reported balance differs from 500 - 10 = 490 by exactly 0.005 (489.995, accepted) or by 0.0051 (489.9949, E13 on that row, panel line 5). The 2024-03 row is consistent with the 2024-02 balance in both variants. Filler loan F1 covers every month end of the window.
